verdict.title: Quick verdict
verdict.body_html: Choose Palm Jumeirah if you want premium waterfront living, privacy, larger homes and a luxury resort-style address. Choose Dubai Marina if you want urban waterfront apartment living, walkability, stronger rental liquidity and easier access to daily lifestyle infrastructure.
verdict.body_text: Choose Palm Jumeirah for premium waterfront living, privacy, larger homes and luxury resort-style address. Choose Dubai Marina for urban waterfront apartment living, walkability, stronger rental liquidity and daily lifestyle infrastructure.

rental_logic.title: Rental logic
rental_logic.body: Rental comparison should not be based only on district name. Primadom AI should compare unit size, view, building quality, service charges, tenant profile, walkability, short-term rental restrictions, management costs and resale liquidity before recommending one area.

items.question: Is Palm Jumeirah better than Dubai Marina for luxury living?
items.answer: Palm Jumeirah usually fits buyers who prioritize waterfront luxury, privacy, beach access and a premium resort-style address. Dubai Marina usually fits buyers who want urban waterfront lifestyle, walkability and apartment liquidity.

items.question: Which area is better for rental income?
items.answer: Dubai Marina is often more rental-liquidity oriented because of apartment supply, walkability and tenant demand. Palm Jumeirah can be strong for premium lifestyle rents, but entry price and unit type matter.

items.question: Which area is better for families?
items.answer: Palm Jumeirah can suit families looking for larger homes, villas and privacy. Dubai Marina can suit families who want apartment living, walkability and daily amenities.
